name: hcapp_addEditProduct
description: Creates or edits one entry in a kennel's catalogue (3.1 payments): a run package, a membership, a piece of haberdashery — what the hasher pays (PricingJson), the per-type rules (ProductDetailsJson) and the supplier detail (SourceJson, admin-only, never syncs). @productId NULL creates; otherwise edits that product, which must belong to @kennelId (1343) so one kennel cannot edit another's. A product is NEVER deleted here: taking it off sale is @isActive = 0, which keeps the row syncing so a payment made against it last year still resolves (James, 2026-09-13). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 103, standard token). Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageProducts' (GM, VGM, Hash Cash, Haberdasher or the ManageHashCash flag) → 1341. Pre-flight before any transaction: name required (1342), all three JSON fields must pass ISJSON (1345). Blank test is LEN()-based so an emoji-only name survives the collation. HC.Product is defined by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_create_Product.sql and 2026-09-13_product_json_rework.sql (PricingJson), not in db/schema/tables.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). No default.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose catalogue this is; the permission scope and the ownership check on edit. No default — omitting it is refused by SQL before the procedure runs.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: NULL (default) = create with a server NEWID(); otherwise the product to edit, which must exist for @kennelId with Removed = 0 → else 1343.

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: Catalogue entry kind (run package / membership / haberdashery …). Default 0.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Required in effect: LEN(COALESCE(@name, '')) = 0 → 1342. Trimmed on write. Default NULL.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description. Default NULL. On edit NULL overwrites (not COALESCE-kept).

parameters.name: pricingJson
parameters.description: How the product is priced, one JSON document so a product can express the model it actually has. Must pass ISJSON when not NULL → else 1345. Syncs. Default NULL.

parameters.name: productDetailsJson
parameters.description: Per-type rules, e.g. {"photos":[…],"sizes":["S","M"]}. Must pass ISJSON when not NULL → else 1345. Syncs. Default NULL.

parameters.name: sourceJson
parameters.description: Supplier detail (cost to the kennel). Does NOT sync — kennel admin data only. Must pass ISJSON when not NULL → else 1345. Default NULL.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: 1 (default) on sale; 0 off sale (the only way to retire a product — never Removed).

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Display order within the catalogue. Default 0.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On any failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1. ValidateAppAuth 1203/1303 (invalid token 1, device 3, signed out 7); 1341 not authorised (errorType 13); 1342 name required (2); 1345 malformed JSON (2); 1343 product not this kennel's (3); 1344 unhandled (5).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: 1 / 3 / 7 auth; 13 not authorised; 2 validation; 3 not found; 5 unhandled.

rowsets.description: Error detail on every failure path (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: a one-column envelope — no errorCode / errorType columns, unlike the failure envelope.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Product (create) with createdAt = updatedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), updatedAtBias 0, Removed 0, CreatedByUserId = caller; or UPDATE HC.Product (edit) of all nine writable columns WHERE id = @productId AND KennelId = @kennelId — inside a transaction.
HC.trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForProduct stamps updatedAt (+ updatedAtBias) on the UPDATE, so the row re-syncs to every phone of the kennel.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1341, 1342, 1345, 1343 (all pre-flight, outside the transaction) and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @kennelId (lines 2-4) have no SQL default. A client that omits @kennelId gets 'expects parameter @kennelId' BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the graceful checks below never fire (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29).

codeSmells.issue: Success envelope lacks the errorCode / errorType columns the failure envelope carries
codeSmells.detail: Line 193 emits SELECT 1 AS success; the failure paths emit { success, errorCode, errorType }. Rowset 0's shape depends on the outcome, so a client reading errorCode must tolerate the column being absent.

codeSmells.issue: Error log text names two of the three JSON fields
codeSmells.detail: Line 130 logs 'productDetailsJson or sourceJson is not valid JSON' while the test at lines 123-125 also covers @pricingJson; a bad PricingJson is logged under the wrong field name.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
